subject: Follow-up: Kestrel Health discovery & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Laine <emma.laine@kestrelhealth.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Kestrel Health discovery & next steps

Hi Emma & Ravi —

Great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary use case: lowering inference cost and improving response time for the Kestrel clinical notes search feature.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 250ms at 10k qps, stable cost per 1M requests, and no PHI persisted outside your VPC.
- Pilot asks: small production pilot (2 endpoints) + SOC2 attestation and audit logging for review.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm who owns the budget for this pilot (economic buyer) and who handles vendor onboarding/procurement? If you can introduce them that would be ideal — otherwise please provide name/email.
2) Would procurement be comfortable with a short onboarding packet (we have a one-page MSA summary + vendor checklist)? Happy to share and walk through in 20 minutes.
3) We recommend a brief security sync with your security/compliance lead so we can pre-share SOC2 + architecture diagram. Who should we loop in?

Attachments: I attached my meeting notes and a short onboarding summary for your procurement team. I'll also drop a mutual action plan (editable) in Drive after you confirm contacts.

Proposed immediate next step: 20-minute procurement + legal intro this week (Thu/Fri). Which time works?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0137

Attachment: discovery-notes-aug21.pdf (stub)
From: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Emma Laine <emma.laine@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Kestrel Health discovery & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick notes: 

- I run the integration workstreams on our side (tech lead) but I am not the budget owner. The economic buyer for projects like this is our CFO, Maya Singh (maya.singh@kestrelhealth.com). 
- Procurement: copied procure@kestrelhealth.com. They handle vendor onboarding and usually want a completed vendor checklist + MSA summary before legal signs off.
- Security/compliance: looping in our InfoSec lead via procurement once vendor paperwork is shared — they typically ask for SOC2 Type II, encryption-at-rest details, and an architecture diagram.

I've attached the vendor onboarding checklist procurement prefers (their template). I'll ask Maya whether she wants a short exec summary for the pilot and will follow up with an intro.

Available for the 20-min sync Thu 11:00–12:00 PT.

Best,
Ravi
Software Engineering Manager | Kestrel Health
ravi.patel@kestrelhealth.com

Attachment: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (stub)
